blocks.title: why your webinar *flopped*, even with 50+ live viewers

blocks.caption: spoiler: it's probably not your slides.

blocks.text:
50 people showed up live. you pitched, sent the replay, and went to bed feeling good.

then the DMs started.

chat.text: is this ok if i'm a total beginner?

blocks.text:
you were writing the replay email. your VA was asleep. "i'll reply tomorrow" became thursday.

by thursday, they had moved on.

blocks.heading: your best leads never said no. they asked *how much* and heard nothing.

blocks.text:
"If you're busy or offline, it feels like leads just move on to whoever responds first."

so you blame the webinar. new offer, new slides, maybe a challenge next month.

**and the same thing happens again.**

it's answering the DMs your webinar creates, while people are still warm.

**the webinar fills the inbox. the inbox closes the sale.**

an AI setter for Manychat. it learns your offer from your sales page in about two minutes, then answers your DMs in your voice, once the lead has finished writing.

it asks one question at a time, only sends your calendar to the right people, and follows up to 3 times within 24 hours.

blocks.caption: your offer, your voice, your objections, ready in about two minutes. example from our site, not a client.

list: your webinar gets judged on what it really produced.
you stop changing strategy every month.
you finally sleep after a webinar (wild, i know).
